# Recording license reference

The [central owner grant](../../../ASSET_LICENSES.md) defines the license scope,
author, attribution and reuse conditions for the complete supplied recordings
and original app exports. The [recording catalog](../../../docs/development/RECORDINGS.md)
identifies exact files, hashes and inclusion authorizations.

The complete [CC BY-SA 4.0 legal text](LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt) is retained
alongside these fixtures for redistribution.
